rule: Raw JSON and CSV files are never overwritten.
All observations use UTC calendar dates.
Exact token-date duplicates are flagged; the latest timestamp is retained for processing.
Non-positive prices are flagged and excluded from log transformations.
A complete calendar is created from first valid observation to cutoff; prices are not forward-filled.
Daily log returns are calculated only when both the current and previous calendar day have valid prices.
Absolute log returns above 100.0% are flagged but not deleted or winsorized.
30-day return standard deviation, annualized with sqrt(365).

Yahoo closing prices are compared with CoinGecko over the recent validation window, allowing a one-day boundary shift. PASS requires at least 100 matches, correlation >= 0.95, median absolute relative difference <= 5%, and 95th-percentile difference <= 15%.
